birth.source: Exactly historical F124-AN paired 7–15-hop birth on new frozen seed/operator catalogue; only new source IDs, opaque operator names and sixteen additional independent public examples. The first 24 demonstrations retain three one-bit output corruptions, new sixteen are clean. All examples are paired identical between positive and negative graphs, independent of graph causal keys; source-only inverse truth preserved.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Increasing independent public observation redundancy from 24 to 40 will allow source-blind robust RANSAC to disambiguate affine maps corrupted by three demonstration bits, unlike F124-AN; out-of-class Feistel should honestly abstain rather than confidently invent a map.
Yggdrasil.method: Use 40x16 public demo inputs plus bias; bounded deterministic GF2 17-sample linear solve, rank verify then residual Hamming to all 40 support pairs. Candidate selection by unique minimum mismatch count <=3 and score-gap among distinct candidates. Preserve original seven-active/nine-retained causal model unchanged; never import operator labels or source-oracle into learner.
Yggdrasil.TRAIN_fit: Maximum paired TRAIN correctness, then fewest confidently wrong TRAIN maps counted evaluator-only after prediction, then FP, then fewer trials and larger margin. Freeze before new DEV.
Yggdrasil.limits: Engineered affine GF2 hypothesis class, public supervised mapping examples, no spontaneous unknown function discovery; Feistel out-of-class

Wingless.hypothesis: Consensus of sequentially recomputed one-state compressed causal scores using independent public 12-bit hash projection can eliminate false positives without holding any second packed node state or losing original long-chain positives.
Wingless.mechanism: Run exact historic F124-AK beta0.5 graph pass once with original checksum [1,3,4,2]; release per-node retained scores; sequentially run same original source-blind packed scorer with ONE alternate hash projection drawn from frozen grid, no concurrent cached node states. Score = minimum of original and alternate scalar logits; active retained states/node never exceeds one 12-bit packet. Extra runtime/temporary state explicitly measured.
Wingless.TRAIN_fit: Exclude candidates losing ANY gamma0 accepted 13–15-hop positive on TRAIN; among eligible minimize FP then maximize paired; tie choose original projection. Freeze before fresh DEV.
Wingless.strict_DEV: All original long-positive case identities retained and fewer FP on same 48 new source-normalized pairs; otherwise result retained negative, no model promotion.
Wingless.condition: All Wingless input graphs are source-verified normalized by evaluator for scientifically isolated packed-scoring test. This does NOT constitute learned operator inference.
